title: cephaelis sulphurea
intro: Cephaelis sulphurea, commonly known as the Yellow Pimpernel, is a plant species native to Central and South America. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cephaelis sulphurea include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
